reason: I'll install the free version because someone in the kindergarten chat will share it, but my son plays any app for about a week and then I delete it. I'm not paying 25 thousand a month for something that will be gone in two weeks, and the free part is enough to see if he even cares.
objection: I don't have a foreign card, and I don't trust Play Market or App Store billing to take money from my Uzcard or Humo without problems. If I can't pay the normal way, it isn't happening, and even if I could, our money goes to food and kindergarten first.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to pay with Click or Payme on Uzcard/Humo for one month only, without auto-renewal, after my son is still asking for the app a month later.
